text: Hallelujah!Blessed the man who fears the Lord,who greatly delights in his commands. [AA]
His descendants shall be mighty in the land,a generation of the upright will be blessed.
Wealth and riches shall be in his house;his righteousness [1] shall endure forever.
Light shines through the darkness for the upright; [AB]gracious, compassionate, and righteous.
It is good for the man gracious in lending,who conducts his affairs with justice.
For he shall never be shaken;the righteous shall be remembered forever. [AC]
He shall not fear an ill report;his heart is steadfast, trusting the Lord.
His heart is tranquil, without fear,till at last he looks down on his foes.
Lavishly he gives to the poor;his righteousness shall endure forever; [AD]his horn [2] shall be exalted in honor.
The wicked sees and is angry;gnashes his teeth and wastes away;the desire of the wicked come to nothing.
